description: The reverse of cited_by: every authority a given opinion RELIES ON (its table of authorities), with a depth count of how many times each is cited. Pass the citing opinion's id. Requires COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN (authentication-only endpoint). Returns cited opinion ids; fetch interesting ones with case_detail (type opinion) or their clusters. A table longer than `limit` continues from the returned next_cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

opinion_id.description: Numeric OPINION id whose authorities to list.

name: case_authorities

description: Fetch a full case by id: a cluster (the case: name, citations, date, judges, and its opinion ids) or a single opinion (paged text, with optional literal phrase search across the whole document). Requires COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN (these endpoints are authentication-only). Use the cluster_id from opinion_search results.

find.description: Opinion only: literal case-insensitive phrase to find at or after offset, including beyond the first page. Returns text beginning at the match and the next match offset.

id.description: Numeric cluster id (default) or opinion id.

max_chars.description: Opinion only: characters per page (default and maximum 50000).

offset.description: Opinion only: normalized-text character offset, default 0. Use next_offset to continue reading or next_match_offset to find the next phrase.

type.description: Which resource `id` refers to (default "cluster"). A cluster is the case; an opinion is one document within it.

name: case_detail

description: Verify legal citations against CourtListener's database of real cases before relying on them; catches fabricated or mangled citations. Pass free text (a brief, memo, or draft) or a single citation string; every citation recognized in the text is checked. Per citation: FOUND (with case name, date, and link) or an explicit NOT_FOUND / UNKNOWN_REPORTER flag. Requires COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN (authentication-only endpoint). Caps: 64000 characters of text and 250 citations per call (server rate limit: 60 citations/min).

text.description: Free text to scan for citations (max 64000 characters), or a single citation string like "410 U.S. 113". The first 250 citations recognized are looked up; any beyond that are returned flagged NOT_CHECKED_OVER_CAP.

name: citation_lookup

description: Every opinion that CITES a given opinion — the free version of a citator check ('is this case still being relied on, and by whom'). Pass an opinion id: an opinion_search hit's `opinions[].id`, or a cluster's sub_opinion_ids from case_detail. Returns citing opinions newest-first or most-cited-first with the same fields as opinion_search. Needs COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN in practice: CourtListener refused anonymous requests with HTTP 401 on 2026-11-28. NOTE: this reports who cites the case; it does NOT classify the treatment (followed/distinguished/overruled) — read the citing opinions.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

limit.description: Max results from this page (1-20, default 20).

opinion_id.description: Numeric OPINION id (not a cluster id). Source: an opinion_search hit's opinions[].id, or case_detail on a cluster, which lists its sub_opinion_ids.

name: cited_by

description: List CourtListener courts and their ids (the values used as the `court` filter in opinion_search / docket_lookup). Optionally filter by jurisdiction code and/or a name substring. Jurisdiction codes include "F" (federal appellate/other), "FD" (federal district), "FB" (bankruptcy), "S" (state), "SA" (state appellate), "SS" (state supreme). Works without a token (verified live 2026-11-28).

q.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against court id / full name / short name / citation string (applied to the fetched page).

name: court_list

description: The actual filing history of a federal docket from the RECAP archive: numbered entries, dates, descriptions, and any archived PACER documents (with page counts and availability). Pass a docket_id from docket_lookup. Requires COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN (authentication-only endpoint). Coverage note: RECAP holds what its users have bought from PACER — an entry or document not present may still exist on PACER.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

name: docket_entries

description: Search court dockets (CourtListener type=r) by case name, free text, and/or docket number, optionally scoped to a court. Returns case name, court, docket number, filed/terminated dates, nature of suit, and a link. Needs COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN in practice: CourtListener refused anonymous requests with HTTP 401 on 2026-11-28.

court.description: Optional court id filter (e.g. "nysd"). Get ids from court_list.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor; fetches the next page (keep the other args the same).

limit.description: Max results from this page (1-20, default 20). The /search/ endpoint returns one fixed page of ~20; to get more, pass the response's next_cursor back as cursor.

q.description: Case name or free-text query (e.g. an employer or agency name).

name: docket_lookup

description: Look up judges / people in CourtListener's judiciary database (type via /people/) by last and/or first name. Returns id, assembled name, birth/death dates and place, gender, and how many positions are on file. Needs COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN in practice: CourtListener refused anonymous requests with HTTP 401 on 2026-11-28.

limit.description: Max people to return (1-20, default 10). /people/ serves one fixed page of 20 and ignores page_size.

name: judge_lookup

description: Full-text search of U.S. case law / court opinions (CourtListener type=o). Returns the top matching page (up to `limit`) with case name, court, date filed, citations, docket number, a snippet, citation count, and a link. Each hit also carries `opinions`: the ids of the opinions in that case, which is the input to cited_by. Needs COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN in practice: CourtListener refused anonymous requests with HTTP 401 on 2026-11-28.

court.description: Optional court id to filter to (e.g. "scotus", "ca9", "nysd"). Get ids from court_list.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor; fetches the next page (keep the other args the same).

filed_after.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only opinions filed on/after.

filed_before.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only opinions filed on/before.

limit.description: Max results from this page (1-20, default 20). The /search/ endpoint returns one fixed page of ~20; to get more, pass the response's next_cursor back as cursor.

q.description: Search query. Supports plain terms and phrases (e.g. "warrantless search", "qualified immunity").

name: opinion_search

description: The text of an oral argument, from CourtListener's Whisper transcript of the recording (/audio/{id}/). Pass an audio_id from oral_arguments. Needs COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN in practice: CourtListener refused anonymous requests with HTTP 401 on 2026-11-28. READ THIS BEFORE QUOTING: the text is MACHINE speech-to-text, never a court reporter's certified transcript — it mishears names, numbers and citations and carries no speaker attribution. CourtListener's own status for the transcription is reported as stt_verdict, and only a COMPLETE one returns text: a recording flagged TRANSCRIPTION_DOES_NOT_MATCH_AUDIO (a Whisper hallucination — 708 of 103,278 records on 2026-09-14) has text on the record and it is withheld here rather than presented as a transcript. Long arguments run past 100,000 characters, so text is paged: up to 50000 characters per call (default 15000), with truncated and next_offset when there is more.

audio_id.description: Numeric audio id, from an oral_arguments hit's audio_id.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (default 0). Pass a previous response's next_offset to continue.

name: oral_argument_transcript

description: Search oral-argument audio recordings (CourtListener type=oa): case name, court, argue date, judges on the panel, duration, and an MP3 download link. Useful for hearing how an issue was actually argued. Needs COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN in practice: CourtListener refused anonymous requests with HTTP 401 on 2026-11-28. The `snippet` on each hit is an excerpt of a machine-generated Whisper transcript, not a certified one; for the transcript text itself pass a hit's audio_id to oral_argument_transcript.

argued_after.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only arguments on/after.

argued_before.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only arguments on/before.

court.description: Optional court id filter (e.g. "scotus", "ca2"). Get ids from court_list.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.

include_transcript_status.description: Report each result's real transcript status (default false). Costs ONE extra API request PER RESULT: the search index does not carry stt_status and /audio/ has no batch id filter (id__in is rejected as an unknown parameter). Left off, every row reads transcript_status "NOT_CHECKED". Lower `limit` before turning this on.

limit.description: Max results from this page (1-20, default 20).

order_by.description: Sort order (default relevance; newest/oldest sort by argue date).

q.description: Search query (case name, party, or topic).

name: oral_arguments
